preconditions.description: The number of groups must be between 1 and 100.
Each group must have between 1 and 100 friends.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= friend <= num_friends for friend in friend_list)
preconditions.description: Each friend label in the friend list must be a valid index within the group.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the most popular friend label and the average distance formatted to six decimal places.
The most popular friend must have the least notoriety among all friends in the group.
The average distance must be calculated as the sum of notoriety values divided by the number of friends.
